'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Paul McPherson LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul McPherson]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Paul McPherson]]

* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
